description: This is a Python source file that defines a comprehensive subtitle correction pipeline. It includes functions for text normalization, grammar and spell correction, OTT compliance enforcement, and optional audio-aware correction using ASR. The module consolidates multiple optional dependencies and provides a public API for processing subtitle cues through various correction stages.

classes.name: WhisperModel
classes.description: Optional class for ASR transcription using the 'faster-whisper' library.

methods.name: List[Dict] correct_subtitles_pipeline( cues: List[Dict], *, language: str = "en", enable_grammar: bool = True, enable_ott_rules: bool = True, enable_audio_correction: bool = False, audio_source: Optional[str] = None, asr_model_name: Optional[str] = None, asr_device: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Main API function to process and correct a list of subtitle cues, including normalization, grammar correction, OTT rules, and optional audio-based correction.

methods.name: str _normalize_text(text: str)
methods.description: Normalize whitespace, punctuation spacing, and quotes in subtitle text.

methods.name: None _apply_grammar_and_spell_corrections(cues: List[Dict], language: str = "en")
methods.description: Apply grammar/spell corrections to subtitle cues if language_tool_python is available.

methods.name: None _apply_ott_compliance_rules( cues: List[Dict], *, language: str = "en", max_lines_per_cue: int = 2, max_chars_per_line: int = 42, enforce_terminal_punctuation: bool = False, )
methods.description: Enforce OTT compliance rules like line length, line count, and punctuation in subtitle cues.

methods.name: List[str] _wrap_text(text: str, max_chars: int, max_lines: int)
methods.description: Wrapper to split text into lines respecting max characters per line and total line count.

methods.name: str _adjust_for_reading_speed(text: str)
methods.description: Use textstat heuristics to refine line breaking for reading speed, if available.

methods.name: None _apply_audio_aware_corrections( cues: List[Dict], *, audio_source: Optional[str], language: str = "en", asr_model_name: Optional[str] = None, asr_device: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Optional function to align subtitle text with recognized speech from audio via ASR.

methods.name: List[Dict] _run_asr( audio_source: str, *, language: str, model_name: Optional[str], device: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Execute ASR using 'faster-whisper' or 'whisper', returning recognized segments.

methods.name: str _collect_asr_text_for_window(segments: List[Dict], start: float, end: float)
methods.description: Collect concatenated ASR output overlapping with a subtitle cue's time window.

methods.name: bool _overlaps(a_start: float, a_end: float, b_start: float, b_end: float)
methods.description: Check if two time intervals overlap.

methods.name: float _timestamp_to_seconds(ts: str)
methods.description: Convert timestamp string in 'HH:MM:SS,ms' format to seconds as float.

methods.name: str _harmonize_text_with_asr(sub_text: str, asr_text: str)
methods.description: Use fuzzy matching to reconcile subtitle text with ASR transcript, replacing tokens when appropriate.

methods.name: List[str] _tokenize(text: str)
methods.description: Split text into tokens (words and punctuation), preserving structure.

methods.name: str _detokenize(tokens: List[str])
methods.description: Reassemble tokens into a string with appropriate spacing.

methods.name: str _match_casing(source: str, template: str)
methods.description: Match casing style of source string to a template string.

methods.name: bool _is_change_reasonable(original: str, corrected: str)
methods.description: Determine if a text correction is acceptable based on similarity metrics.
